description: Append-only ledger of FLAKES: tests that failed a scope and then passed on an equivalent re-run (CI diagnostics step, coverage instrumentation context, or a local re-run). This is the L5 counterpart to tests/qpm-ledger.json (escaped defects). A flake that reaches a green state is recorded like an escape, so intermittent tests get fixed instead of re-run. Add an entry whenever the failed-scope diagnostic (or a local re-run) shows a scope passing after failing; never edit an entry's rootCause/fix after the fact. Enforced by Tests/FlakeLedger.Tests.ps1: no entry may stay OPEN longer than maxOpenDays, and no more than maxNewPerRolling30Days entries may appear in any rolling 30-day window. The committed file must validate clean.

entries.test: AuditLedger - path, export, range, and tamper detection.exports filtered ledger data and verifies a requested range
entries.detectedIn: github run 43412243523 (core shard 1/4); passed locally and on the CI re-run diagnostic
entries.rootCause: the -Not -Match assertion matched the whole JSON payload, and the ledger entries carry Base64 HashChain/PreviousHash substrings that contain 'a2' at random chance; nondeterministic assertion, not a product defect
entries.fix: this pass - assert on the serialized key shape '"Action":"a2"' instead of the bare substring

entries.test: Resolve-BuildProjectRoot reports HasMarker=$false and keeps the start dir when the walk is bounded out
entries.detectedIn: github run 43388525320 (coverage shard 6/12) under coverage instrumentation; passed on re-run
entries.rootCause: the bounded-walk fixture lived directly under the host temp tree and inherited whatever ancestor the CI runner happened to have; a marker found above the fixture made HasMarker=$true. Non-hermetic test fixture, not a product defect.
entries.fix: d6defda (hermetic marker-less orphan base under GetTempPath)
